task.title: Control who can see you
task.shortdesc: Hide from new people, limit who can say hi, and choose what your card shows before you match.

step.cmd: Under Nearby, change the options you want.

chrow.chdesc: Nobody new can see you, and you won't see anyone new.
Everyone nearby, People with 2 or more shared interests, or Nobody. You can still say hi to anyone.

step.cmd: Under Account, tap Edit profile and change what your card shows.

chrow.chdesc: Turn it off to show an age range, such as 25 to 34, instead of your age.
Choose After we match to keep your photo from people you haven't matched with.

step.info: You can also change your photo, first name, line, and interests here. Your date of birth can't be changed.
